title: Image OCR
description: Extract text from images using OCR, running entirely in your browser. Supports English and Simplified Chinese. Free, no upload.
howToUse: Upload an image, choose a recognition language (English or Simplified Chinese), and click Recognize. Progress is shown live. Copy the extracted text with one click. All processing is local — nothing is uploaded.
